descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Mayday puts you in the left seat when things go wrong.

14 EMERGENCIES
Total power loss on final. An engine fire on the climb-out. A ditching at sea. A night blackout. A jammed landing gear and a belly landing. A hydraulic failure, a decompression at 35,000 ft, a storm landing in a crosswind. An autorotation in the helicopter. A flameout and a dead-stick landing in the fighter. Each one is scored, with a checklist card in the cockpit and a red handle to pull.

A REAL GLASS COCKPIT
A business jet with live flight displays, a moving map, an autopilot and a cabin you can walk through. When the power fails the screens really go dark, and the standby battery brings one back.

WEATHER
Clear, overcast or storm: rain past the windows, distant lightning and a real crosswind that makes you crab onto the runway.

FIRE CREWS
Declare a mayday and the airport fire trucks roll, chase you down the runway and pull up beside you.

YOUR OWN HANGAR
Three aircraft in your hangar. Paint them your way and power wash them clean, then choose one and fly.

FREE FLIGHT AND MISSIONS
Fly the island with no failures at all, or switch on surprise failures and see what breaks. Landing challenges, ring courses, fighter missions and landmarks to discover.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
